prompt: Narrow static/mock consistency refactor only. Make both DispatchEnvelope.build and RelayDispatcher.dispatch use exactly that helper. Preserve all current behavior: timeout validation in RelayDispatcher unchanged; payload deep-copy snapshot behavior in DispatchEnvelope unchanged; omitted timeout and explicit None same intent; finite timeout differences conflict; key-order determinism; blocked payload override rules; retry=0/fallback disabled; stop/cancel/error semantics; no live/network/auth/API/billing/settings/persistence changes. Do not add new layers/files unless strictly required. Add focused tests that prove the helper gives equal hashes for equivalent nested payload/key order and that DispatchEnvelope and RelayDispatcher duplicate/conflict behavior remain consistent for None and finite timeouts. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, and git diff --check.
